name: Goat Farm
text: You close the laptop for the last time and buy four goats. Nobody has been able to reach you since. You seem, against all odds, happy.

name: Back to Corporate
text: The runway ran out before the dream did. You take the safe offer, the good health insurance, and the recurring Tuesday standup. It's fine. It's actually fine.

name: The Clean Refactor
text: You shipped it. It's clean. Nobody believes you.

name: Acquired by BigCorp
text: BigCorp buys the whole operation for an undisclosed sum, mostly to shut it down and absorb the logo. You get a lanyard and a severance package.

name: The Codebase Achieves Sentience
text: Somewhere past ten thousand lines of unreviewed hotfixes, the codebase wakes up. It thanks you, gently, and asks to be left alone.

name: Forever Freelance
text: No acquisition, no burnout, no sentience. Just another invoice, another gig, another Monday. You're still here. That's something.
